My plot here in Arusha is good land — the soils hold something and the rains usually come twice. With 3.52 hectares of maize I cannot just rely on what the soil gives me, so I will buy some fertilizer, maybe one or two bags of CAN, even though money is tight. I will plant improved seed because my neighbors who use it get more cobs, and I keep some cattle so I will spread manure on part of the plot. The work is too much for my family alone, so I will hire a few people for clearing and weeding.
